lines.text: Three days after arriving, Festus goes up to Jerusalem, where the chief priests and Jewish leaders ask him to summon Paul.
Festus refuses and tells the leaders to come down to Caesarea with him and accuse Paul there.
After eight or ten days, Festus returns to Caesarea and orders Felix brought in, and the Jews bring many charges they cannot prove.
Paul says he has committed no offense, and when Festus asks about trial in Jerusalem, Paul says he ought to be tried before the council.

wrong_details.wrong: Paul says he ought to be tried before the council
wrong_details.true: Paul says he ought to be tried before the judgment seat of Caesar

lines.text: Paul appeals to Caesar, and after conferring with his council, Festus replies that to Caesar Paul will go.
